description: This file contains utility functions for manipulating nested integer tuples, including structure matching, flattening, shape calculations, and coordinate conversions, specifically used for tensor shape and index operations in a distributed context.

methods.name: TypeIs[int] is_int(x: object)
methods.description: Checks if the provided object is an integer based on the Integer type alias.

methods.name: TypeIs[tuple] is_tuple(x: object)
methods.description: Checks if the provided object is a tuple.

methods.name: tuple[IntTuple,...] as_tuple(x: IntTuple)
methods.description: Converts an integer or nested tuple into a tuple of IntTuples.

methods.name: bool match_structure(a: IntTuple, b: IntTuple)
methods.description: Recursively checks if two IntTuples have the same nested structure.

methods.name: tuple[int,...] flatten(t: IntTuple)
methods.description: Recursively flattens a nested IntTuple into a flat tuple of integers.

methods.name: int signum(a: int)
methods.description: Returns -1, 0, or 1 depending on the sign of the input integer.

methods.name: int product(a: IntTuple)
methods.description: Computes the product of all integers in an IntTuple, recursively.

methods.name: int inner_product(a: IntTuple, b: IntTuple)
methods.description: Calculates the inner product of two IntTuples.

methods.name: int tuple_max(a: IntTuple)
methods.description: Returns the maximum integer in a nested IntTuple.

methods.name: IntTuple shape_div(a: IntTuple, b: IntTuple)
methods.description: Performs shape-aware integer division with ceiling, accommodating nested tuples.

methods.name: IntTuple suffix_product(a: IntTuple, init: IntTuple = 1)
methods.description: Computes suffix product of an IntTuple, used for index calculations.

methods.name: IntTuple idx2crd(idx: IntTuple, shape: IntTuple, stride: IntTuple | None = None)
methods.description: Converts a linear index (IntTuple) to coordinate (multi-dimensional index) based on shape and stride.

methods.name: int crd2idx( crd: IntTuple | None, shape: IntTuple, stride: IntTuple | None = None )
methods.description: Converts coordinate (multi-dimensional index) into a linear index based on shape and stride.

methods.name: IntTuple crd2crd( crd: IntTuple, dst_shape: IntTuple, src_shape: IntTuple | None = None )
methods.description: Transforms coordinates from one shape to another, used for tensor reshaping.

methods.name: tuple|int slice_(crd: tuple | int | None, trg: tuple | int)
methods.description: Filters target elements based on coordinate tuples, similar to slicing.

methods.name: bool has_none(a: tuple | int | None)
methods.description: Checks recursively if an IntTuple contains None at any terminal.

ctags.name: crd2crd
ctags.signature: ( crd: IntTuple, dst_shape: IntTuple, src_shape: IntTuple | None = None )

ctags.name: crd2idx
ctags.signature: ( crd: IntTuple | None, shape: IntTuple, stride: IntTuple | None = None )

ctags.name: idx2crd
ctags.pattern: /^def idx2crd(idx: IntTuple, shape: IntTuple, stride: IntTuple | None = None) -> IntTuple:$/
ctags.signature: (idx: IntTuple, shape: IntTuple, stride: IntTuple | None = None)

ctags.name: slice_
ctags.pattern: /^def slice_(crd: tuple | int | None, trg: tuple | int) -> tuple | int:$/
ctags.signature: (crd: tuple | int | None, trg: tuple | int)
